Left-click to select a Gift.
Right-click or long-press to view its details.

Fusion Gifts have a red border.
Pack-exclusive Gifts have a yellow heptagonal frame.

Use the [-] [+] [++] buttons to view upgrade info.
Right-click or click outside to close the window.

If the Gift is used in a Fusion, the recipe is shown.
Click a Gift in the recipe to view its details.

Pack-exclusive Gifts show the banner of the Pack they appear in.
Click the banner to view the Pack's details.

This is the Pack's detail view.
You can check its floors and unique Gifts.

Click a material Gift in the recipe
to view that Gift's details.
Cursed and Blessed Gifts show their related Gifts.
